notes: gain = suggested linear playback gain. Ambience loops are mastered to -20 LUFS; one-shots are peak-normalised to -1 dBTP and their gain brings them to a role loudness (loud -14, medium -18, soft -22, ui -23 LUFS momentary max). Loops are sample-exact periodic: loop the whole buffer (samples = loop length).

amb_harbour.description: Battery Park waterfront: water lapping on the sea wall, gulls, a distant ferry horn, light cold wind, faint city behind.

amb_street.description: Busy downtown street (Broadway, Financial District): traffic hum, tyres and passing cars/cabs/buses with doppler, cab horns, footsteps, pedestrian murmur, slap-back off the buildings.

amb_chinatown.description: Dense Chinatown market street: close crowd babble, hand-cart wheels, crates and metal clatter, plastic bags, a far vendor calling out, light traffic.

amb_timessquare.description: Times Square: a dense crowd hubbub, synth-pop bleeding from the giant screens, lots of impatient cab horns, crawling traffic.

amb_rooftop.description: Rooftop: strong cold November wind gusts whistling round parapets and antennas, the city roar far below, an HVAC unit, a faint far siren.

amb_park.description: Central Park in winter: wind through bare branches with twig rattle and creaks, crows, sparrows, kids playing and shouting in the distance, a far dog, the city faintly beyond.

amb_construction.description: Construction site: jackhammer bursts, a truck reverse beeper, steel hammer clangs, a diesel generator drone, traffic behind.

amb_tunnel.description: Subway tunnel: low tunnel drone, third-rail electrical hum, dripping water, ticking metal, distant train rumble - all in a boomy metallic tunnel reverb.

amb_station.description: Subway station platform: crowd murmur and footsteps in a long bright tiled reverb, garbled PA announcements, turnstile clacks, distant trains, fluorescent hum.

amb_wind_low.description: Neutral gentle wind bed for low airspeed; smooth, no spikes. Crossfade with amb_wind_high by airspeed.

amb_wind_high.description: Neutral fast-airflow rush for high airspeed: brighter turbulent roar with a hint of whistle. Crossfade with amb_wind_low.

train_pass_uptown.description: Express train blasting past in a tunnel, left to right: approach, wheel-joint clatter, motor whine, rush of air, doppler recede.

train_pass_downtown.description: Express train blasting past in a tunnel, right to left (different train).

train_arrive.description: Train pulling into the station: slowing clatter, brake screech, stop clunk, pneumatic hiss.

train_horn.description: Subway train horn: harsh buzzy two-tone blast, echoing down the tunnel.

door_chime.description: Generic descending two-tone "ding-dong" door chime through a platform speaker (not the real MTA chime).

cab_horn_1.description: Yellow cab horn: quick impatient double tap.

cab_horn_2.description: Yellow cab horn: long lean then a short jab.

cab_horn_3.description: Yellow cab horn: rapid triple tap, lower pitched.

cab_horn_4.description: Yellow cab horn: sharp single beep then an annoyed lean, higher pitched.

car_horn_long.description: Car horn held down for nearly two seconds (gridlock rage).

bus_brake_hiss.description: City bus stopping: brief brake squeal then the big pneumatic "pssssh".

siren_pass.description: NYPD-style police car passing: wail, switching to yelp with a low rumbler as it passes, doppler and building echoes.

truck_pass.description: Heavy diesel truck rumbling past with rattles and doppler.

steam_hiss.description: Steam puffing from a manhole / street steam stack (about 2 s).

steam_burst.description: Sudden, powerful steam burst with a pressure pop and roaring hiss.

pigeon_flap.description: Pigeon taking off: wing claps then flapping away.

gull_cry.description: Herring gull long call over the harbour: a "kyow" then laughing "ha-ha-ha".

crow_caw.description: Crow cawing three times, harsh and raspy.

cat_hiss.description: Alley cat hissing with a spit.

man_shout_hey.description: Grown man shouting "hey!" (a startled New Yorker).

crowd_cheer.description: Warm joyful crowd cheer with applause and whistles - for planting the seed.

leaf_flutter_loop.description: Seamless loop: the dry leaf fluttering/flapping in fast airflow. Fade in with airspeed.

leaf_tear_small.description: Small dry-leaf tear: a short crisp rip.

leaf_tear_big.description: Big leaf rip: a long, ragged paper tear with snaps.

leaf_hit_wall.description: Soft papery thwack of the leaf slapping into a wall.

puddle_splash.description: Leaf lands in a puddle: splash and droplets (death).

manhole_fall.description: Falling down a manhole: whoosh down a pipe into an echoey drop and splash below.

train_hit.description: Hit by a train: a sudden overwhelming roar and screech that cuts to silence with a faint ring.

whoosh_drop.description: Layer-drop speed boost: big satisfying swept whoosh crossing the stereo field with a sub-bass drop.

whoosh_drop_big.description: Roof-to-subway combo drop: rising tension, a huge whoosh, deep sub boom and rushing tail.

corkscrew_whoosh.description: Corkscrew: whoosh spiralling around the head with accelerating rotation.

loop_whoosh.description: Loop-the-loop: one big circular whoosh rising and falling as it sweeps around.

gust_blast.description: A sudden strong gust of cold wind slamming in then easing off.

vent_blast.description: Shot up a metal air-vent shaft: fan hum, rising metallic rush with duct resonance and rattling sheet metal.

seed_plant.description: Planting the seed: a soft earthy thud and crumble, then a gentle rising magical shimmer.

achievement_chime.description: Achievement unlocked: a warm, short, rewarding rising arpeggio with a soft glow.

ui_back.description: Soft UI back/cancel: two quick descending blips.
